subject: Reminder about recycling and gate
text: Just remembered, after the reply I sent about the recycling cart, I should have said more clearly that the pickup moved because the driver came by too early last week and left the second bin on the curb. So, reminder, maybe? The cart needs to be at the corner by seven tomorrow, not seven thirty as I first wrote, since that earlier note was based on what I assumed from the posted schedule, which apparently changed. If you already rolled it out, okay, but please pull it back to your curb tonight, because the city may not take anything sitting past the driveway, and then the bottles will sit around all weekend. Also, the side gate latch is still loose, so do not lean the extra boxes against the wall; stack them under the porch instead, near the old bench, though the bench is probably being moved soon. One more thing: if you see a blue truck instead of the usual green one, let me know, or just wave, because I will not be home and my son only has the spare key for emergencies. I know this is messy, and I already replied once, but I did not want to send a proper correction email and then forget to say that I left the garden scissors somewhere between your garage and the community shed. Sorry.
